resolution.note: ship test with PR #1449's captured check-runs (failed attempt 1, in-progress attempt 2) waits past the merge bound and merges on the rerun success instead of exiting 74

title: Ship reads a rerun Check as its stale failed attempt
body:
Evidence: PR #1449, run 44381299774. After `gh run rerun 44381299774 --failed` (attempt 2 in_progress), two `krn pr ship` reruns (.krn/runs/lead/ship-actions-refused-2.log, -3.log) exited 74 at once with "Check concluded failure" from attempt 1; attempt 2 then concluded success and a fourth ship merged (f11db40).
Outcome: ship waits on the newest attempt of the required Check: a completed run superseded by a queued or in-progress rerun of the same Check is pending, not red.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, src/repo/required-check.ts
Proof: a ship test with a captured check-runs reply holding a failed attempt 1 and an in-progress attempt 2 waits instead of exiting 74.
